ken: Heads-up — Q4 capacity planning call notes. Forecast shows a sharp winter surge and vendor lead times are slipping. Need a decision on reservation mix by EOD Fri.

maria: Can you drop the numbers? how sharp is "sharp"? :eyes:

ken: Quick summary: baseline GPU hrs 2.0M/month, projected peak Dec = 3.1M (∼55% increase). Traffic skew: chat gen +80% token volume, embeddings +30%.

apoorv: Re: vendor lead times — H200 vendors now quoting 18-26 weeks for new chassis. H100 availability ok but price +8% vs Q2. L40S still best for spot/short-term with immediate availability in US-west but limited APAC stock.

lisa: Oof. That 18-26w for H200 is rough. We can’t rely on just spot for APAC customers. We need a regional hedge.

maria: Cost tradeoffs: our current unit economics (hosted): H200 reserved = $0.95/GPU-hr, H100 reserved = $0.78/GPU-hr, L40S spot avg = $0.45/GPU-hr but preemption risk impacts 95th perc latency.

apoorv: Quick calc (back-of-envelope):
```
Peak month demand = 3.1M GPU-hrs
If we reserve 40% => 1.24M reserved hrs
Reserve mix options:
 - Option A: 60% H200 / 40% H100 => heavier latency SLOs covered, cost ~ $0.88 avg
 - Option B: 40% H200 / 30% H100 / 30% L40S => cost ~ $0.72 avg but higher preempt risk in spots
```

ken: Our customer SLAs (enterprise tier) require <200ms p95 for text-gen. That pushes us toward H200 coverage for canary regions.

lisa: Region constraints: APAC demand concentrated in SIN and TYO. Vendors can stage H100 shipments to SIN faster than H200. Proposal: reserve H200 mostly in US-east and EU-central for enterprise; rely on H100 + reserved L40S pools for APAC.

maria: Also consider cross-region routing policy: if APAC H200 capacity shortfall, route enterprise reads to EU-central with sticky tokens for stateful sessions. Ops impact noted.

apoorv: Procurement update: procurement-bot says vendor "NexGenCompute" offering 10% expedite for 6-week cut in lead time but requires 50% deposit at PO. Expedited capacity limited to 200 units.

procurement-bot: NexGenCompute quote attached: PO# NG-5587, net-30, expedite fee 10%, est ship 42 days if expedite. Link: https://procure.internal/nexgen/NG-5587

ken: Tradeoff: pay expedite to secure APAC H200 capacity vs. accept routing lat penalties. Cost of expedite roughly adds $0.09/GPU-hr if fully amortized across term.

maria: Suggested plan (for decision):
- Reserve 30% capacity across fleet (by GPU-hr) today: 45% H200 / 35% H100 / 20% L40S.
- Purchase expedited 120 H200 units for APAC (covering the 6-week shortfall) — finance signoff needed.
- Short-term increase spot pools in US-west to smooth burst.
- Action: ken to prep PO recommendation, maria to run cost sensitivity, apoorv to negotiate expedited terms. Deadline: Friday EOD.

lisa: +1 to that plan. Also request: add a fallback rollout plan for canaries to degrade model profile (fewer layers) if preemptions spike.

apoorv: I'll push vendor for staged deliveries and confirm whether we can split deposit across shipments. Also checking if H200 microconfigs (mem optimized) are available — those might help cost per token.

ken: Risks: 1) vendor lead time creep 2) finance pushback on 50% deposit 3) network egress if routing cross-region. Call out network costs: cross-region egress estimate +$0.02/token for some workloads.

maria: Ops checklist before PO: inventory mapping of reserved pools to customers (which enterprises locked to which pool), estimated uplift from caching/batching improvements (we can probably shave 8-12% off peak with aggressive prefix caching).

procurement-bot: Pending approvals: Budget owner: @maria, Security signoff: @lisa, Finance approval: @kevin-fin. Estimated total CAPEX (expedited 120 H200 + 6-month amortization) = $1.1M.

ken: OK — I'll assemble a one-pager with numbers and the PO recommendation. Will include sensitivity table for 10/20/40% demand chg. Expect in 24h.

lisa: Thanks. Quick note: timeline dependency matrix please include network cabling lead times for APAC colo (vendor said 2 weeks once rack delivered).

maria: :thumbsup: if you're on board.

apoorv: :+1:

lisa: :+1:

ken: Closing thread — will post the one-pager and a small scoreboard: reserve %, expedited units, PO draft. If no objections by Fri EOD we'll file PO.
